grammar.purpose: Describe how an action is performed
grammar.explanation: 笑得很开心 describes the manner of laughing; it does not establish permission to tease. A 得 complement follows the verb. Keep the example’s degree distinct from how many times an action occurred.

examples.py: tā xiào de hěn kāi xīn .
yīn yuè xiǎng de tīng bù qīng huà .
examples.en: The music is so loud that speech cannot be heard.

examples.py: wǒ shuō de tài kuài le .

commonMistakes.why: Put the degree complement after the verb and 得.

grammar.pattern: 一点儿也 / 都 + 不 / 没
grammar.explanation: 一点儿也不生气 emphasizes no anger; it does not mean a little angry. 一点儿也没听懂 emphasizes lack of understanding of the specified material. Do not substitute this for merely 没完全听懂.

examples.py: tā yì diǎn ér yě bù shēng qì .
examples.en: She is not angry at all.

examples.zh: 这一句我一点儿也没听懂。
examples.py: zhè yī jù wǒ yì diǎn ér yě méi tīng dǒng .
examples.en: I did not understand this sentence at all.

examples.py: wǒ yì diǎn ér dōu bù xiǎng chǎo jià .
examples.en: I do not want to quarrel at all.

commonMistakes.wrong: 一点儿也不生气是有点儿生气。
commonMistakes.right: 一点儿也不生气是完全不生气。
commonMistakes.why: The negation is emphatic, not a small positive degree.

lines.zh: 你刚才笑什么？我说错了吗？
lines.py: nǐ gāng cái xiào shén me ? wǒ shuō cuò le ma ?
lines.en: What were you laughing at? Did I say something wrong?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是，你拿杯子的样子让我想到昨晚那部剧。
lines.py: bù shì , nǐ ná bēi zi de yàng zi ràng wǒ xiǎng dào zuó wǎn nà bù jù .
lines.en: No. The way you held the cup reminded me of last night's drama.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 哪部？我也想看。
lines.py: nǎ bù ? wǒ yě xiǎng kàn .
lines.en: Which one? I'd like to watch it too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 就是你推荐的那部。她说不想吃糖，手却还在往杯子里加。
lines.py: jiù shì nǐ tuī jiàn de nà bù . tā shuō bù xiǎng chī táng , shǒu què hái zài wǎng bēi zi lǐ jiā .
lines.en: The one you recommended. She says she doesn't want sugar but keeps adding it to her cup.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 她每次都这样，我看到那里也笑了。
lines.py: tā měi cì dōu zhè yàng , wǒ kàn dào nà lǐ yě xiào le .
lines.en: She always does that. I laughed at that part too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 这杯奶茶真的很甜。你要不要换我的绿茶？
lines.py: zhè bēi nǎi chá zhēn de hěn tián . nǐ yào bù yào huàn wǒ de lǜ chá ?
lines.en: This milk tea really is sweet. Would you like my green tea instead?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不用，你自己喝。我下次记得少放糖就好了。
lines.py: bù yòng , nǐ zì jǐ hē . wǒ xià cì jì de shǎo fàng táng jiù hǎo le .
lines.en: No, keep yours. I'll remember less sugar next time.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那下次看剧别让我选茶，你会怪我的。
lines.py: nà xià cì kàn jù bié ràng wǒ xuǎn chá , nǐ huì guài wǒ de .
lines.en: Don't let me choose the tea for our next drama night then. You'll blame me.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我只会怪你提前把后面说出来。
lines.py: wǒ zhǐ huì guài nǐ tí qián bǎ hòu miàn shuō chū lái .
lines.en: I'll only blame you for telling me what happens next.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，我不说了。你先看到第五集再来找我。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ bù shuō le . nǐ xiān kàn dào dì wǔ jí zài lái zhǎo wǒ .
lines.en: Fine, I won't. Come back when you've reached episode five.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: A smile is not an answer
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 新朋友第一次来家里看剧，我给她倒了一杯奶茶。她喝了一口，说很香，又把杯子放在桌上。
lines.py: xīn péng you dì yī cì lái jiā lǐ kàn jù , wǒ gěi tā dào le yī bēi nǎi chá . tā hē le yī kǒu , shuō hěn xiāng , yòu bǎ bēi zi fàng zài zhuō shàng .
lines.en: A new friend came over for drama night. I poured milk tea; she took a sip, called it fragrant and put the cup down.

lines.zh: 我以为她不喜欢，正想换一杯，她却指着电视笑起来。原来剧里的人也在喝茶，还把糖放个不停。
lines.py: wǒ yǐ wéi tā bù xǐ huān , zhèng xiǎng huàn yī bēi , tā què zhǐ zhe diàn shì xiào qǐ lái . yuán lái jù lǐ de rén yě zài hē chá , hái bǎ táng fàng gè bù tíng .
lines.en: I was about to replace it, thinking she disliked it, when she laughed at the television. The character was drinking tea and adding sugar endlessly.

lines.zh: 我问她是不是也觉得太甜。她说是有一点，不过让她笑的是那个人说不想吃糖，手却一直没停。
lines.py: wǒ wèn tā shì bú shì yě jué de tài tián . tā shuō shì yǒu yī diǎn , bù guò ràng tā xiào de shì nà gè rén shuō bù xiǎng chī táng , shǒu què yì zhí méi tíng .
lines.en: I asked whether she found it too sweet. A little, she said, but the joke was the character saying she didn't want sugar while continuing to add it.

lines.zh: 后面两个人吵起来，声音很大。我想问她站在哪一边，她说先看完吧，现在还不知道谁把杯子换了。
lines.py: hòu miàn liǎng gè rén chǎo qǐ lái , shēng yīn hěn dà . wǒ xiǎng wèn tā zhàn zài nǎ yī biān , tā shuō xiān kàn wán ba , xiàn zài hái bù zhī dào shéi bǎ bēi zi huàn le .
lines.en: Two characters later argued loudly. When I asked which side she took, she said to finish watching first: we still didn't know who'd switched the cups.

lines.zh: 结束以后，她帮我把桌上的杯子收好。我们都忘了喝第二杯，凉了的茶倒是没刚才那么甜。
lines.py: jié shù yǐ hòu , tā bāng wǒ bǎ zhuō shàng de bēi zi shōu hǎo . wǒ men dōu wàng le hē dì èr bēi , liáng le de chá dǎo shì méi gāng cái nà me tián .
lines.en: Afterward she helped clear the cups. We'd both forgotten our second cup; cold, it didn't seem as sweet as before.

lines.zh: 她走到门口又回头说，下次还有茶吗？我说有，不过这次糖放多少，你自己来。
lines.py: tā zǒu dào mén kǒu yòu huí tóu shuō , xià cì hái yǒu chá ma ? wǒ shuō yǒu , bù guò zhè cì táng fàng duō shao , nǐ zì jǐ lái .
lines.en: At the door she asked whether there'd be tea next time. Yes, I said, but she'd decide how much sugar to add.

lines.zh: 你说不提前告诉我，怎么又笑了？
lines.py: nǐ shuō bù tí qián gào sù wǒ , zěn me yòu xiào le ?
lines.en: You promised no spoilers. Why are you laughing again?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我看见你的表情了，跟剧里那个人一模一样。
lines.py: wǒ kàn jiàn nǐ de biǎo qíng le , gēn jù lǐ nà gè rén yī mú yī yàng .
lines.en: Your expression's exactly like that character's.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 别看我，看电视！
lines.py: bié kàn wǒ , kàn diàn shì !
lines.en: Watch the television, not me!
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好好好。你刚才说看完要讨论，可别先睡着。
lines.py: hǎo hǎo hǎo . nǐ gāng cái shuō kàn wán yào tǎo lùn , kě bié xiān shuì zháo .
lines.en: All right. You said we'd discuss it afterward; don't fall asleep first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我才不会，茶太甜了，我现在一点儿都不困。
lines.py: wǒ cái bù huì , chá tài tián le , wǒ xiàn zài yì diǎn ér dōu bù kùn .
lines.en: I won't. The tea's so sweet I'm wide awake.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那正好，你来洗杯子。
lines.py: nà zhèng hǎo , nǐ lái xǐ bēi zi .
lines.en: Perfect. You can wash the cups.

lines.py: yuǎn chù chuán lái le qì chē de shēng yīn .

lines.py: nǎi nai gěi wǒ men jiǎng le yī gè chuán shuō .

lines.zh: 这个箱子超级重。

lines.zh: 我今天超级开心。

lines.en: I'm super happy today.

lines.zh: 这顿饭好吃极了。

lines.en: This meal is delicious.

lines.zh: 听到这个消息，她高兴极了。
lines.py: tīng dào zhè gè xiāo xī , tā gāo xìng jí le .
lines.en: She was delighted by the news.

lines.zh: 我的桌子太乱了。

lines.en: My desk is a mess.

lines.zh: 别把纸放乱了。
lines.py: bié bǎ zhǐ fàng luàn le .
lines.en: Don't mess up the papers.

lines.zh: 我弟弟最近迷上了足球。
lines.py: wǒ dì di zuì jìn mí shàng le zú qiú .
lines.en: My brother's got really into football lately.

lines.zh: 她很迷这个演员。
lines.py: tā hěn mí zhè gè yǎn yuán .
lines.en: She's really into this actor.

lines.zh: 真巧，我们坐的是同一班车。
lines.py: zhēn qiǎo , wǒ men zuò de shì tóng yī bān chē .
lines.en: What a coincidence: we're on the same bus.

lines.zh: 你也住这里？太巧了。
lines.py: nǐ yě zhù zhè lǐ ? tài qiǎo le .
lines.en: You live here too? What a coincidence.

lines.zh: 大家热烈欢迎新同学。
lines.py: dà jiā rè liè huān yíng xīn tóng xué .
lines.en: Everyone warmly welcomed the new classmate.

lines.zh: 讨论进行得很热烈。
lines.py: tǎo lùn jìn xíng de hěn rè liè .
lines.en: The discussion was lively.

lines.zh: 这个面包闻起来很香。
lines.py: zhè gè miàn bāo wén qǐ lái hěn xiāng .

lines.zh: 刚做好的饭很香。
lines.py: gāng zuò hǎo de fàn hěn xiāng .
lines.en: The freshly cooked meal smells lovely.

lines.zh: 我想要一杯热奶茶。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng yào yī bēi rè nǎi chá .
lines.en: I'd like a hot milk tea.

lines.zh: 这家的奶茶有点儿甜。
lines.py: zhè jiā de nǎi chá yǒu diǎn ér tián .
lines.en: This place's milk tea is a little sweet.

lines.zh: 她喜欢喝绿茶。
lines.py: tā xǐ huān hē lǜ chá .
lines.en: She likes green tea.

lines.zh: 我给你带了一包绿茶。
lines.py: wǒ gěi nǐ dài le yī bāo lǜ chá .
lines.en: I've brought you a packet of green tea.

lines.zh: 猫的白毛掉在椅子上了。
lines.py: māo de bái máo diào zài yǐ zi shàng le .
lines.en: The cat shed white fur on the chair.

lines.zh: 这只狗的毛很长。
lines.py: zhè zhǐ gǒu de máo hěn zhǎng .
lines.en: This dog's fur is long.

lines.zh: 我只是想问一下时间。
lines.py: wǒ zhǐ shì xiǎng wèn yī xià shí jiān .
lines.en: I just wanted to ask the time.

lines.zh: 她只是来送东西，不留下吃饭。
lines.py: tā zhǐ shì lái sòng dōng xi , bù liú xià chī fàn .
lines.en: She's only dropping things off, not staying for a meal.

lines.zh: 这件衣服很好，就是贵了一点。
lines.py: zhè jiàn yī fú hěn hǎo , jiù shì guì le yī diǎn .
lines.en: This garment's good, just a little expensive.

lines.zh: 路不远，就是现在下雨了。
lines.py: lù bù yuǎn , jiù shì xiàn zài xià yǔ le .
lines.en: It isn't far; it's just raining now.

lines.zh: 据说这个公园下周开门。
lines.py: jù shuō zhè gè gōng yuán xià zhōu kāi mén .
lines.en: I hear this park opens next week.

lines.zh: 据说她以前住在这里。
lines.py: jù shuō tā yǐ qián zhù zài zhè lǐ .
lines.en: I hear she used to live here.

lines.zh: 手机不断响，我没法看书。
lines.py: shǒu jī bù duàn xiǎng , wǒ méi fǎ kàn shū .
lines.en: My phone keeps ringing, so I can't read.

lines.zh: 这几天不断有人来问。
lines.py: zhè jǐ tiān bù duàn yǒu rén lái wèn .
lines.en: People have kept coming to ask over the last few days.

lines.zh: 这里下雪是很少见的现象。
lines.py: zhè lǐ xià xuě shì hěn shǎo jiàn de xiàn xiàng .
lines.en: Snow is a rare phenomenon here.

lines.zh: 我们讨论了这个现象的原因。
lines.py: wǒ men tǎo lùn le zhè gè xiàn xiàng de yuán yīn .
lines.en: We discussed the cause of this phenomenon.

lines.zh: 这件事的重要性你已经知道了。
lines.py: zhè jiàn shì de zhòng yào xìng nǐ yǐ jīng zhī dào le .
lines.en: You already know this matter's importance.

lines.zh: 我想提高练习的积极性。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng tí gāo liàn xí de jī jí xìng .
lines.en: I'd like to feel more enthusiastic about practising.

lines.zh: 把照片放正一点。
lines.py: bǎ zhào piān fàng zhèng yī diǎn .
lines.en: Straighten the photo a little.

lines.zh: 椅子没放正，我来移动一下。
lines.py: yǐ zi méi fàng zhèng , wǒ lái yí dòng yī xià .
lines.en: The chair isn't straight; I'll move it.
